免费榜方面，本周[Subway Surfers City](https://app.sensortower-china.com/overview/6504188939?country=DE)在德国、[Arrows – Puzzle Escape](https://app.sensortower-china.com/overview/6748397500?country=IN)在印度、[Order Crazy: Water Sort Puzzle](https://app.sensortower-china.com/overview/6751222488?country=JP)在日本及[Block Blast！](https://app.sensortower-china.com/overview/1617391485?country=US)在英美市场登顶；[Block Blast！](https://app.sensortower-china.com/overview/1617391485?country=DE)在德国、印度与日本，[Magic Sort!](https://app.sensortower-china.com/overview/6499209744?country=DE)在德国、英国与美国，以及[Subway Surfers City](https://app.sensortower-china.com/overview/6504188939?country=US)在美国市场则从榜首滑落。
